The cafe, open 9 to 11, every day

All-day breakfast, smoothie bowls, thin-crust pizza and cold brew. Plates come out on fishing nets. About ₹1,800 for two.

Work from the deck

Plants, blue-painted furniture and WiFi that guests rate 8.3 out of 10 on Booking.com. Coffee is one room away, and there's a terrace when you need air.
